findings.label: Suppressed effect dependency on `variants`
findings.detail: useEffect reads `variants` but omits it from the dependency array (eslint-disable). Harmless today because variants only change when slug changes, but will silently break if real-time stock updates are added. Revisit when reactive stock is introduced.

findings.label: Redundant aria-hidden on no-variant placeholder
findings.detail: <div className="mt-7" aria-hidden /> uses aria-hidden on an empty presentational div. The attribute is redundant (browsers skip empty divs already) and should be removed for clean markup.
